Work out what guests pay now and on arrival

Use the price of the whole reservation, including everyone in the group. Choose the deposit type you advertise. A fixed group deposit collects the same amount up front across different booking totals. A percentage scales with the value of each reservation. Divide by the guest count to estimate an equal share. For a private tour with a minimum group charge, start with the actual quoted total. Dividing the advertised per-person price across the guests can understate what is due when the minimum applies.

Take deposits for Shopify tour bookings →

Worked example

Four guests book a private tour for $480 in total. A 25% deposit collects $120 up front and leaves $360 due later. With an even split, each guest contributes $30 now and $90 on the day.

Booking Deposit Calculator FAQ

How do I model a fixed deposit per guest?

Multiply the per-guest amount by the number attending, then enter that sum as the fixed group deposit. For six guests paying $15 up front each, enter a $90 deposit.

Is an advance booking deposit the same as a refundable security deposit?

An advance payment reduces the price still due for a service. A refundable security deposit on rental equipment is held separately. Use the rental quote generator if your customer needs both figures on one document.

How do I calculate a 30% booking deposit?

Multiply the booking total by 0.30. For a $250 appointment that gives $75 due now and $175 remaining. Enter 30 in the percentage field to compare it with a fixed deposit.

What happens when the deposit cannot split evenly between guests?

The split distributes the remaining cents across the group. A $10 deposit shared by three people is two payments of $3.33 and one of $3.34.

How can I compare deposits for small and large groups?

Run the same percentage and fixed amount against two different booking totals. A $50 fixed deposit covers half of a $100 booking and one tenth of a $500 booking.

Does the calculator collect payment or update my checkout?

It gives you figures you can copy into a quote or booking confirmation. Configure the chosen payment amount and collection schedule in your booking or checkout setup.
